summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Save My Edits' on-device persistence. Flow: guest login -> skip tutorial -> open /tmp/sample.pdf (3 pages) -> pen stroke on page 1 -> insert blank page at end (add-page-2 -> 'Blank page', 4 pages) -> rotate page 1 (rotate-active-btn) -> wait 2s for debounce -> close tab (tab-close-*) -> reopen from recent-<id>. FIRST RUN FAILED: reopen showed toast 'Could not reopen this file.' and the Start screen stayed; the stored state's sourceBlobs had size 0 and recents meta had size:0. RCA: pdf.js getDocument({data}) TRANSFERS the ArrayBuffer to its worker, detaching the Uint8Array; openCore/mergeFile created new Blob([buf]) AFTER calling buildPdfPages(), so every persisted source blob was empty (0 bytes) and reopen could not parse the PDF. I applied the in-scope fix (snapshot bytes with buf.slice() into the Blob BEFORE loading, in both openCore and mergeFile; also captured byteSize before openCore for the recents size). AFTER FIX all round-trip assertions PASS: page count restored 4/4, page-1 annotation restored (1293 non-transparent alpha px, identical to pre-close), rotation restored (page-1 wrapper 1179x833 vs portrait 833x1179), all 4 wrapper rects byte-identical to pre-close, stored IndexedDB state = {pages:4, kinds:[pdf,pdf,pdf,blank], rotations:[90,0,0,0], annotations:[1,0,0,0], activePageId preserved, sourceBlob 1435 bytes}. Merge round-trip also verified: merge sample.pdf -> 6 pages, both source blobs persisted (1435,1435), reopen restores 6 pages with both sources rendering. No console errors, no pageerrors, no error toasts after the fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Recent card page count is stale: after inserting a page (3 -> 4) and closing the tab the card still reads '3 pages' (localStorage pdf_recents.pages is only updated inside openRecent, not by the debounced save). Cosmetic but misleading.

integration_issues.issue: WAS BROKEN before my fix - persisted sourceBlobs were 0 bytes because pdf.js detached the buffer before the Blob snapshot; reopen always failed with 'Could not reopen this file.'. Fixed in Workspace.js (buf.slice() snapshot before buildPdfPages) and re-verified end-to-end.

action_items: Review/keep my fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Workspace.js: source Blob must be snapshotted (buf.slice()) BEFORE loadPdfDocument/buildPdfPages because pdf.js transfers the ArrayBuffer (this also fixed recents size:0).
Also apply the same 'copy bytes before pdf.js load' rule anywhere else raw buffers are reused (e.g. any future import/export path) - openRecent is safe because it re-reads from the Blob.
Update the recents metadata (pages count) from the debounced saveDocState so recent cards show the edited page count.
Replace the two empty catch blocks in Workspace.js (lines 148 saveDocState, 278 openFromDevice) with logging - the persistence failure was silent, which hid this bug.
critical_code_review_comments: saveDocState swallows all errors in an empty catch: an IndexedDB/structured-clone failure would silently lose all user edits with no feedback. Log and surface a toast/indicator.

mergeFile mutates doc.sources/doc.sourceBlobs directly before dispatching COMMIT; the debounced save depends on the [docs] identity change, so a merge with no page change would not be persisted. Prefer immutable updates through the reducer.
Workspace.js is 651 lines and owns open/persist/edit/export logic - consider extracting the persistence layer (saveDocState/openRecent) into a hook.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of persistence checks pass after the buffer-detach fix (0% before it)

seed_data_creation: Regenerated /tmp/sample.pdf (3 x A4 pages, title text + rectangle) with pdf-lib.
test_credentials: Guest login via [data-testid=guest-login-btn]; fully client-side, no server auth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Persistence verified end-to-end (annotations + inserted blank page + rotation + activePageId + merged sources) after fixing the pdf.js ArrayBuffer-detach bug in Workspace.js. Each browser-automation run starts with a clean profile, so the whole open->edit->close->reopen flow must be done inside ONE script. Useful probes: read localStorage 'pdf_recents' for the recentId, and read IndexedDB db 'pdfstudio' store 'files' key 'state:<recentId>' to inspect pages/rotations/annotation counts and sourceBlob sizes (a size of 0 means the detach bug regressed). Untested: image-page insert persistence, page reorder/delete persistence, and Export after reopen.
rca_of_the_issue: pdf.js's getDocument({data}) transfers ownership of the typed array's ArrayBuffer to the worker thread, leaving the caller's Uint8Array detached (byteLength 0). openCore() and mergeFile() built the persisted `new Blob([buf])` AFTER awaiting buildPdfPages(buf), so every stored sourceBlob was 0 bytes. On reopen, loadPdfDocument on an empty buffer threw, the catch showed 'Could not reopen this file.' and the document never opened - all edits appeared lost. Fix: snapshot bytes (buf.slice()) into the Blob before the pdf.js load; verified reopen now restores page count, annotations, rotation and merged sources exactly.
